scope: Catalog admin create forms (slug fields) + product-model ACTIVE/INACTIVE visibility toggle: create forms for category/brand/model expose a Slug field, and the product-model edit form gains a Status select backed by a new admin model list and status route

businessFlow.subject: Admin catalog workspace exposes Slug on category/brand/product-model create forms and toggles a product model ACTIVE<->INACTIVE with server-enforced status and an INACTIVE-visible admin list

notes: This slice completes the 'all declared options are exposed' verification: the attribute create form already rendered every declared control (category, key, label, dataType TEXT/NUMBER/BOOLEAN/JSON, unit, sortOrder, filterable, required). The product-model (and, for consistency, category/brand) create forms now expose an optional Slug field (auto-derived from the name when blank, matching the edit modal). The product-model edit modal now exposes a Status select (Active/Inactive) that drives a new PATCH /api/v1/admin/product-models/:id/status route (server-enforced via setCatalogStatus, audited CATALOG_PRODUCT_MODEL_DEACTIVATED/ACTIVATED) and a new GET /api/v1/admin/product-models admin list that includes INACTIVE models so they can be reactivated; migration 0051 relaxes the two product_models CHECK constraints. Verified headed end-to-end: PCX Gaming Tower toggled to Inactive (muted pill) then back to Active with no error banner; a fresh page load records zero failed API requests.
